Multi-repository tabs, faster incremental refreshes, word-level inline diffs, large-diff protection, split-view line picking, and renamed file fixes.

### Multi-repository tabs

- Opening another repository adds a tab strip at the top of the window so you can switch between repositories without losing your scroll position, view, undo history, or running terminals.
- Each open repository keeps its own file watcher and terminal sessions until you close its tab.

### Faster refreshes and responsive staging

- Worktree and index changes (editing files, staging, unstaging) now run a lightweight status refresh instead of reloading the full commit graph, refs, stashes, and commit count.
- Rapid clicks on stage, unstage, and discard actions are queued sequentially rather than dropped while another lightweight action is running.
- File watching ignores common build and cache folders (`dist`, `.next`, `.nuxt`, `.venv`, `__pycache__`, `.cache`, `.turbo`).

### Upgraded Diff viewer

- **Inline word-level diff**: modified lines highlight the exact changed tokens in both unified and split views.
- **Large diff protection**: diffs over 2,000 lines collapse behind a **Show diff anyway** guard, and single-file diff output is capped at 1.5 MB on the Rust side so giant lockfiles or bundles never stall the app.
- **Split-view line picking**: click or shift-click lines in side-by-side mode to stage, unstage, or discard individual lines.

### Architecture & Fixes

- Fixed staged renamed files (`R`, `+0 −0`) displaying as entirely newly added lines in the diff viewer; renamed files now diff against their original path, show `old → new` in the header, and display **Renamed without changes** for pure renames.
- Unstaging a staged renamed file now unstages both the old and new paths together.
- Moved transient overlays (context menus, dialogs, command palette) out of `AppContext` and added selector support to `useSettings` to eliminate unnecessary full-tree re-renders.
- Split oversized views (`History`, `PullRequests`, `Chrome`, `Settings`) into focused submodules.
- Kept the lower commit graph drawn when the list height is stale.

### Install

Use **Update** in the app (Settings → About), or download the file below. The builds are not signed with a paid certificate yet: right-click the app and choose **Open** the first time (or run `xattr -cr "/Applications/Git Graph.app"`). Pull requests, Issues, Actions and CI/CD use the [GitHub CLI](https://cli.github.com) sign-in (`gh auth login`).
